# OpenTrust Verify

> Trust the balance, not just the blockchain event.

OpenTrust Verify (OTV) is a hosted API from POP Trust. You send an incoming-transfer claim. We return a signed verdict that says whether the named recipient can spend what arrived.

A blockchain explorer can show that something happened. OTV checks inclusion, execution, asset, recipient, balance change, and finality on Ethereum, Bitcoin, Solana, Tron, Base, and other EVM networks.

## Product

- Home: https://otv.poptrust.me/
- Public verifier: https://otv.poptrust.me/verifier
- How a check runs: https://otv.poptrust.me/whitepaper
- About: https://otv.poptrust.me/about
- Security: https://otv.poptrust.me/security

## Developers

- Integration guide: https://otv.poptrust.me/docs
- OpenAPI: https://otv.poptrust.me/api/docs
- Source: https://github.com/aishikumar91/opentrustverify

## API

- POST https://otv.poptrust.me/v1/verify/incoming
- GET https://otv.poptrust.me/v1/verdicts/{id}
- POST https://otv.poptrust.me/v1/verdicts/verify
- GET https://otv.poptrust.me/v1/chains

Authenticate with an API key or a session. Google sign-in is available on the hosted site.

## Do not confuse

OTV does not custody assets, send transactions, or treat a mock adapter result as live chain proof.
